# LeanCTX — The Context OS for AI Development

> LeanCTX is an open-source context runtime that sits between AI coding agents and codebases. It compresses file reads by up to 99%, persists memory across sessions, verifies outputs, and works with 24+ AI tools. Single Rust binary, CLI-first, privacy-first. Zero telemetry.

## What is LeanCTX?

LeanCTX (lean-ctx) is the operating system for AI context. It intercepts every file read, shell command, and search query between your AI tool and codebase, then compresses, caches, and verifies the output before it reaches the model.

Three integration modes:
- **CLI-Redirect** (recommended): Zero MCP overhead. AI agents call `lean-ctx` via shell commands. Used by Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI.
- **Hybrid**: MCP for cached reads (13 tokens per re-read) + CLI for shell/search. Used by Windsurf, Amp, Antigravity.
- **Full MCP**: 56 intelligent MCP tools. Used by JetBrains, Copilot, Cline, VS Code.

## Six Pillars of the Context OS

1. **Smart I/O**: 10 read modes (full, map, signatures, diff, aggressive, entropy, task, reference, lines, auto). AST-aware compression via tree-sitter for 18 languages. Graph-aware reads with dependency hints. 95+ shell compression patterns.
2. **Intelligence**: Intent classification (What/How/Do), adaptive pipeline, graph-powered hybrid search (BM25 + semantic embeddings + graph proximity via RRF), knowledge-enriched overview, progressive search throttling, terse mode.
3. **Memory**: Persistent sessions, project knowledge with temporal facts, multi-edge dependency graphs (imports, calls, exports, type_ref, tested_by), agent handoffs, session survival engine with structured recovery queries.
4. **Governance**: 5 built-in roles (Admin, Coder, Debugger, Reviewer, Ops), workflow gates, token/cost/shell budgets, SLOs with automatic throttling.
5. **Verification**: Proof artifacts for every session, output checks (hallucinated paths, broken imports, secret leaks), replayability, security layer.
6. **Integrations**: 24+ AI tools, 3 integration modes, background daemon, smart auto-setup.

## Real Token Savings

| Operation | Without lean-ctx | With lean-ctx | Saved |
|:---|---:|---:|:---:|
| File reads (cached) | 30,000 tokens | 195 tokens | 99% |
| git status/log/diff | 8,000 tokens | 2,400 tokens | 70% |
| ls / find | 6,400 tokens | 1,280 tokens | 80% |
| Test runners | 10,000 tokens | 1,000 tokens | 90% |
| **Typical session** | **~89,800** | **~10,620** | **88%** |

Active developers save **$30-100+ per month** on AI API costs.

## Key Facts

- Version: 3.5.12
- License: MIT + Apache-2.0 (dual-licensed)
- Language: Rust (single binary)
- Install: `curl -fsSL https://leanctx.com/install.sh | sh` or `npm install -g lean-ctx-bin` or `cargo install lean-ctx` or `pi install npm:pi-lean-ctx`
- Setup: `lean-ctx setup` (auto-configures shell + all detected editors)
- Telemetry: Zero. None. Ever. Everything runs 100% locally.
- Repository: https://github.com/yvgude/lean-ctx
- Website: https://leanctx.com
- Discord: https://discord.gg/pTHkG9Hew9

## Supported AI Tools (24+)

Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, Pi, VS Code, Zed, OpenAI Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Cline, Roo Code, Google Antigravity, OpenCode, Aider, Amp, AWS Kiro, JetBrains IDEs, Amazon Q Developer, Trae, Continue, Crush, Hermes, Sublime Text, Emacs, Neovim.

Pi has a dedicated first-class package: `pi install npm:pi-lean-ctx` — see https://pi.dev/packages/pi-lean-ctx

## MCP Tools

Full tool manifest with schemas: https://leanctx.com/generated/mcp-tools.json

Core tools: ctx_read, ctx_shell, ctx_search, ctx_tree, ctx_overview, ctx_session, ctx_knowledge, ctx_intent, ctx_verify, ctx_impact, ctx_semantic_search, ctx_gain, ctx_cost, ctx_benchmark.

## FAQ

**How much does lean-ctx cost?**
Free and open source. MIT + Apache-2.0 dual-licensed.

**How much money does lean-ctx save?**
Active developers save $30-100+ per month on API costs. Use `lean-ctx gain --score` to measure your savings.

**Does it work with Claude Code / Cursor / Copilot?**
Yes — 24+ AI tools supported. Run `lean-ctx setup` for automatic configuration.

**Does it slow down my AI tool?**
No. <1ms overhead per operation. Most users report faster AI responses because less data means faster LLM inference.

**Is it safe?**
Zero telemetry. Everything runs locally. PathJail sandbox, size caps, TOCTOU mitigation, prompt injection hardening — all active by default.

**What is Context OS?**
Context OS is the architecture that manages the full lifecycle of AI context: what your agent sees, remembers, verifies, and delivers. It replaces ad-hoc prompt engineering with a systematic runtime.
